coachEvents.text: Lead uppercut, rear uppercut, lead uppercut — time-and-a-half, sixteen bars. Uppercuts only, lead, rear, lead. Rip them short.
Jab, rear uppercut, lead hook, cross — straight time, eight bars. Jab, rear uppercut, hook, cross. Level up, then over.
Jab, lead uppercut, cross — double-time, nineteen bars. Jab, lead uppercut, cross. Quick up the middle, then finish long.
